correctness.rationale: The exact quadratic energy identity gives the sampled minimum eigenvalue. Congruence yields a strictly convex reciprocal-diagonal minimization with Slater qualification. Every optimal residual matrix has rank one or two; rank two forces one of exactly three sign-vector certificates, and rank one forces an outer-product matrix and the exact Heron triangle inequality. The converse in both ranks supplies a positive-semidefinite dual with complementarity. Unique minimizer and all equality cases follow. Exact rational replay on 1000 triples independently checks primal and dual identities, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The smallest frustrated positive-correlation triangle is a natural exact sampling design not reducible to the inverse-positive M-matrix rule. An all-parameter explicit four-candidate classification replaces an SDP and distinguishes an exact double-minimum-eigenvalue triangle regime from a simple sign-eigenvector regime. Pairwise-unequal rational examples in the non-gaugeable region realize both phases, and finite rational primal-dual certificates allow transparent application to exact one-step randomized coordinate descent.
